name: Oak
flavor: Your Timber Sentinel takes root as a mighty Oak, its bark groaning with ancient strength.

name: Redwood
flavor: A towering Redwood rises at your command, casting long shadows across the battlefield.

name: Willow
flavor: A gnarled Willow springs forth, its drooping branches swaying with an eerie sentience.

name: Pine
flavor: A tall Pine stands sentinel, its needles bristling like a thousand tiny spears.

name: Birch
flavor: A pale Birch appears, its white bark gleaming like bone in the light.

name: Maple
flavor: A broad Maple takes shape, its crimson leaves rustling with arcane energy.

name: Elm
flavor: A stately Elm rises, its sweeping canopy providing cover from above.

name: Ash
flavor: An Ash tree materializes, its wood humming with the memory of ancient weapons.

name: Cedar
flavor: A fragrant Cedar appears, its aromatic wood filling the air with a calming scent.

name: Cypress
flavor: A somber Cypress takes form, standing like a dark spire against the sky.

name: Yew
flavor: A twisted Yew emerges, its poisonous berries glistening with deadly promise.

name: Ironwood
flavor: An Ironwood sentinel stands firm, its trunk as unyielding as forged steel.

name: Ebony
flavor: An Ebony tree rises, its dark heartwood absorbing the light around it.

name: Baobab
flavor: A massive Baobab swells into existence, its trunk wide enough to shelter a small army.

name: Elder
flavor: An Elder tree takes root, its hollow trunk whispering with fey secrets.

name: Rowan
flavor: A Rowan springs up, its bright berries warding against dark enchantments.

name: Hawthorn
flavor: A thorny Hawthorn bristles into being, its sharp spines daring any foe to approach.

name: Sequoia
flavor: A colossal Sequoia erupts from the ground, dwarfing everything in its shadow.

name: Banyan
flavor: A sprawling Banyan unfurls, its aerial roots descending like grasping fingers.

name: Magnolia
flavor: A Magnolia blooms into existence, its enormous white flowers radiating primal power.

name: Juniper
flavor: A hardy Juniper takes shape, its twisted form speaking of centuries of endurance.

name: Larch
flavor: A golden Larch rises, its soft needles shimmering with an otherworldly glow.

name: Spruce
flavor: A towering Spruce stands at attention, its symmetrical form a monument to natural order.

name: Walnut
flavor: A sturdy Walnut materializes, its dense wood radiating an aura of resilience.

name: Cherry
flavor: A Cherry tree appears in full blossom, its pink petals drifting like gentle snow.

name: Hickory
flavor: A tough Hickory takes root, its famously resilient wood cracking with latent energy.

name: Dogwood
flavor: A flowering Dogwood blooms into being, its delicate appearance belying inner strength.

name: Beech
flavor: A smooth-barked Beech rises, its silver trunk etched with what appear to be ancient runes.

name: Poplar
flavor: A tall Poplar shoots skyward, its leaves trembling and whispering battlefield intelligence.

name: Chestnut
flavor: A broad Chestnut takes form, its spiny fruit pods ready to rain down on the unwary.

name: Sycamore
flavor: A mottled Sycamore appears, its peeling bark revealing layers of hidden power.

name: Hemlock
flavor: A dark Hemlock rises, its drooping boughs casting deep, concealing shadows.

name: Alder
flavor: An Alder springs up, its wood hardening on contact with the air like living armor.

name: Teak
flavor: A Teak sentinel stands resolute, its oily wood resistant to rot and ruin alike.

name: Mahogany
flavor: A regal Mahogany takes shape, its rich reddish wood gleaming with noble authority.

name: Acacia
flavor: A thorny Acacia rises, its flat canopy spreading like a shield against the sun.

name: Olive
flavor: An ancient Olive tree twists into being, its gnarled trunk telling a story of a thousand years.

name: Fig
flavor: A broad Fig tree materializes, its thick leaves providing cover and its roots gripping the earth.

name: Palm
flavor: A towering Palm sways into existence, its fronds rustling with tropical fury.

name: Mangrove
flavor: A tangled Mangrove rises from the ground, its arching roots creating an impassable barrier.

name: Aspen
flavor: An Aspen appears with quaking leaves, each one catching the light like a tiny golden mirror.

name: Cottonwood
flavor: A Cottonwood bursts forth, releasing a cloud of white fluff that drifts across the field.

name: Holly
flavor: A prickly Holly takes shape, its sharp evergreen leaves and red berries promising pain to the careless.

name: Laurel
flavor: A Laurel tree rises proudly, its aromatic leaves crowning it in victory before the fight begins.

name: Sandalwood
flavor: A fragrant Sandalwood appears, its sweet scent disorienting nearby foes.

name: Petrified Oak
flavor: A Petrified Oak rises like a stone monolith, its ancient wood turned harder than granite.

name: Ghostwood
flavor: A translucent Ghostwood shimmers into being, its pale trunk flickering between planes.

name: Bloodthorn
flavor: A Bloodthorn tree erupts, its crimson sap oozing from thorns that seem to hunger.

name: Starleaf
flavor: A luminous Starleaf tree appears, its silver leaves catching light that isn't there.

name: Darkwood
flavor: A Darkwood sentinel emerges, its impossibly light yet strong timber defying natural law.

name: Wraithwood
flavor: A Wraithwood tree fades into existence, its bark shifting like smoke frozen in time.

name: Bronzebark
flavor: A Bronzebark tree stands firm, its metallic trunk ringing softly like a struck bell.

name: Whispering Ash
flavor: A Whispering Ash takes root, its leaves murmuring prophecies in a language long forgotten.

name: Stonepine
flavor: A Stonepine rises with a grinding rumble, its trunk and branches as hard as living rock.

name: Frostwood
flavor: A Frostwood tree crystallizes into being, its icy branches crackling with frozen energy.

name: Emberthorn
flavor: An Emberthorn smolders into existence, its bark glowing with veins of inner fire.

name: Duskwood
flavor: A Duskwood tree materializes in a swirl of shadow, its canopy dimming the light around it.

name: Goldleaf
flavor: A Goldleaf tree shines into being, its brilliant foliage glittering like a dragon's hoard.

name: Thunderoak
flavor: A Thunderoak cracks into existence with a deafening boom, static dancing along its bark.

name: Spiralwood
flavor: A Spiralwood tree twists upward in impossible helixes, its grain defying geometry.
